title: PlanScope Privacy Policy Record
description: Provider-level privacy and data-handling policy at data/providers/<provider>/privacy.yaml. Every policy field carries its own source and checked_at — never fill fields from second-hand information alone. Use value: null for unknown. Plan-specific overrides may live in the plan notes.

id.description: Stable slug, must equal the file name under privacy/ (e.g. consumer / business).

provider.description: Must equal the parent directory id under data/providers/.

scope.description: Set when this record covers only one product surface/audience; api/web/coding/consumer/business policies may differ materially.

region.description: Short region code (e.g. cn, global) when privacy policies differ by region. Use a separate record per region — do not merge cn/global policies.

business_consumer_policy_differs.description: 企业/团队版与个人消费版的政策是否存在实质差异（如训练承诺相反）。

coding_agent_tools_restricted.description: Restrictions targeting automated coding agents such as OpenClaw / Claude Code / OpenCode style callers.

training_persistent_storage.description: 是否为训练目的持久化存储请求内容 —— 与 used_for_training、retention、ZDR 相互独立，不可互相推导。

content_safety_review.description: 请求内容是否经过安全审核（如大陆开放平台明确、海外页面未提时按来源分开记录）。

user_data_isolation.description: 用户数据与其他用户/用途的隔离。

policyField.description: A single privacy fact. value: null = unknown (do not guess). source must be a direct URL (official policy/ToS preferred); second-hand claims belong in community/ instead.

source.description: Direct URL of the evidence. null only when value is also null (unknown).
